Sterling given suspended jail sentence for dangerous driving
uutiset.s: Former England player Raheem Sterling has been given a suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway.

uutiset.t: Sterling's career was defined by comebacks - this could be one too many
uutiset.s: There once existed a time where Raheem Sterling was an unstoppable force. A player with a uniquely abstract running style, he still somehow evoked effortless poise when moving with the ball. A glider across a pitch.

uutiset.t: 'You question everything' - Haaland lays City's frustrations bare
